stem.text: Which instruments are appropriate for tissue dissection in the hepatocystic triangle? (Select all that apply.)

feedback.text: Correct. The hook is commonly used for sharp/electrocautery dissection.
Correct. The dissector is used for blunt and fine tissue separation.
Correct. Suction may be used for take away of tissue.
Incorrect. The clip applier is used for vessel or duct ligation, not dissection.
